new_finding_candidates.title: Pre-handler inbox claim makes Failed/Pending delivery permanently skip on retry
new_finding_candidates.trigger: Decorator is adopted with the current save-through repository; first handler fails after claim, or process stops between claim and handler; same event is redelivered.
new_finding_candidates.impact: Exists returns true for durable Failed/Pending, so decorated work is not retried. This is a source-level failure of the reusable decorator contract, not proof of loss in the currently wired Rabbit event bus.
new_finding_candidates.reachability: No production decorator registration/construction found in BuildingBlocks, Services or Gateway; only the three mock tests construct it.
new_finding_candidates.dedup: Active bus post-handler best-effort receipt gap is already INV-COMM-4/T05; its algorithm differs and does not use this pre-handler decorator.
new_finding_candidates.proposed_regression: Persist claim; fail decorated handler once; retry same event and require eventual successful invocation. Separately cover abandoned Pending recovery and live concurrent owner exclusion.
new_finding_candidates.recommendation: Do not enable this decorator as an exactly-once claim. Define recoverable claim/processing ownership and processed-only terminal dedup semantics, coordinated with business transaction and existing bus keys.

new_finding_candidates.title: All DbUpdateException insert failures are treated as duplicate success
new_finding_candidates.trigger: An AddAsync write fails with DbUpdateException that does not prove an existing same-key inbox record.
new_finding_candidates.impact: Decorator returns without executing business handler or propagating failure; a caller could acknowledge unprocessed work.
new_finding_candidates.reachability: Same dormant decorator limitation; not attributed to active RabbitMqEventBus.
new_finding_candidates.dedup: Distinct failure classification from the persisted Failed/Pending retry problem; root owns whether to group or assign separate stable IDs.
new_finding_candidates.proposed_regression: Inject a proved same-key unique conflict and a separate non-duplicate DbUpdateException. Only the proved duplicate may enter the selected duplicate/recovery policy; unrelated failure must propagate.
new_finding_candidates.recommendation: Inspect specific persistence conflict evidence and expected key/status; do not infer duplicate from the outer EF exception class.

new_finding_candidates.title: Untyped AUTHORIZATION code is mapped by earlier AUTH prefix to 401
new_finding_candidates.trigger: Filter receives ErrorType.Failure/None with code AUTHORIZATION.FORBIDDEN or another AUTHORIZATION.* code.
new_finding_candidates.impact: Legacy fallback returns 401 before the intended 403 branch. Typed Forbidden remains 403.
new_finding_candidates.reachability: Filter registered in five APIs, but no current Services producer of untyped AUTHORIZATION.* was found. ForbiddenException is handled by separate exception middleware; no current user incident asserted.
new_finding_candidates.dedup: No matching stable finding title/evidence found in current register; root must triage before registering.
new_finding_candidates.proposed_regression: Add untyped AUTHORIZATION.FORBIDDEN/ROLE_REQUIRED cases, preserving AUTH_REQUIRED=401 and typed Forbidden=403.
new_finding_candidates.recommendation: Handle the more specific authorization prefix before the generic authentication prefix or remove heuristic dependence after producer migration.
